(2) The camera pans to show more amulets hanging from the rearview mirror, including ones from different shrines like Senso-ji and Izumo Taisha. (3) The scene shifts to the interior of a different car where a person with blonde hair and tattoos is sitting in the driver's seat. (4) Hands are seen handling several packaged mahjong-themed air fresheners, showing different tiles like 'White Dragon' and 'Fa'.
